evidencePolicy.externalSourceRequirement: Classifier compatibility, changed tone, aspect, particle force, dative order, spatial category, register, and phonological conclusions require independently checkable Cantonese evidence.

sources.citation: Glossika Cantonese (HK) A1, Week 19, Cantonese – Classifiers / Function Words, 2026-07-26
sources.scope: Exact source forms, order, glosses, register labels, tone rows, and lesson groupings only.
Current modular owners and project matches; zero independent linguistic evidence weight.

sources.citation: Tse, Shek Kam, Hui Li, and Shing On Leung. 2007. The acquisition of Cantonese classifiers by preschool children in Hong Kong. Journal of Child Language 34(3):495–517.
sources.scope: Cantonese classifier acquisition requires attention to classifier semantics and syntax; the system is not reducible to English gloss labels.

sources.citation: Li, Hui, and Elaine C. M. Wong. 2014. Comparing classifier use in 1995 and 2010 early child Cantonese to explore social change in Hong Kong. Chinese Language and Discourse 5(1).
sources.scope: Reports common Cantonese classifiers including 架 gaa3 and documents overextension of general and broad classifiers in child usage.

sources.citation: A Construction-based Approach to Cantonese Classifiers. 2024. Proceedings of the International Conference on Head-Driven Phrase Structure Grammar.
sources.scope: Classifier phrases with and without an overt numeral require compositional NP structure; a bare classifier can receive cardinality-one interpretation in suitable contexts.

sources.citation: Aspectual clause wrappers source map, CP021B-R24
sources.scope: Perfective 咗, experiential 過, preverbal 未, and final 未 question profiles remain distinct.

sources.citation: Coverb and manner event modification source map, CP021B-R23
sources.scope: Locative 喺 profiles and event-location requirements; category and clause function remain separate.

sources.citation: Lai, Ryan Ka Yau, and Michelle Man-Long Pang. 2023. Rethinking the Description and Typology of Cantonese Causative–Resultative Constructions: A Dynamic Constructionist Lens. Languages 8(2):151.
sources.scope: Cantonese result, phase, and complement structures require construction-specific analysis; 到 cannot receive one uniform complement label.

sources.citation: Sybesma, Rint, and Boya Li. 2007. The dissection and structural mapping of Cantonese sentence final particles. Lingua 117(10):1739–1783.
sources.scope: Sentence-final particles form a structured and multifunctional system; tone, host clause, co-occurrence, and discourse context matter.
㗎 gaa3 has multiple clause- and discourse-sensitive profiles rather than one emphasis meaning.

sources.citation: Xie, Qin, Yue Sara Zhang, and Francesco-Alessio Ursini. 2023. Spatial Categories in Cantonese: Morpho-Syntactic Analysis Meets Discourse Distribution.
sources.scope: Cantonese spatial grammar distinguishes verb-like predicative spatial elements from nominal-like localizers and spatial nouns.

sources.citation: Kwan, Wing-man. 2005. On the word order of locative prepositional phrases in Cantonese: processing, iconicity and grammar. University of Hong Kong thesis.
sources.scope: Cantonese locative phrase position and interpretation are constrained; spatial forms cannot be treated as one freely positioned class.

sources.citation: Lam, Olivia S. C. 2014. Double object constructions and the anomalous syntax of GIVE in Cantonese. Language Sciences 45:71–95.
sources.scope: Neutral lexical 畀 GIVE places theme before recipient and differs from other Cantonese ditransitive patterns.

sources.scope: Neutral theme-before-recipient order and vulnerability of recipient-before-theme order to English influence.

sources.citation: Lam, Charles, Chaak-ming Lau, and Jackson L. Lee. 2024. Multi-Tiered Cantonese Word Segmentation. LREC-COLING 2024:11993–12002.
sources.scope: Cantonese numeral strings remain internally compositional even where a surface tier groups them.

claims.claim: Cantonese classifiers combine semantic tendencies with conventional noun-specific selection; one English class gloss does not define exhaustive compatibility.
claims.boundary: The classifier matrix records semantic profiles and current modular rules but promotes no classifier–noun pair.

claims.claim: The source reading 架 gaa2 conflicts with direct Cantonese classifier research reporting 架 gaa3 for vehicles.
claims.boundary: Preserve the source value in the corpus package; do not import it into pronunciation or compatibility resources.

claims.claim: 架 and 部 overlap in the broad vehicle domain but are not freely interchangeable; 部 additionally covers machines and devices in the current modular rule.
claims.boundary: Exact noun compatibility remains a corpus and controlled-judgment question.

claims.claim: Numeral–classifier phrases may occur with an overt noun or with recoverable nominal material omitted; bare 一杯 in the dialog is contextually interpretable as a cardinality-one classifier phrase.
claims.boundary: Do not invent a fixed omitted noun or treat every bare classifier as an unrestricted fragment.

claims.claim: 幾多杯咖啡 and 兩杯茶 contain quantity plus classifier plus noun structure, while 一杯 can stand as a context-linked nominal answer.
claims.boundary: A separate permanent quantity-construction identity is not established by this lesson.

claims.claim: 嘅, 喺, 咗, 緊, 過, and 到 belong to different lexical and grammatical profiles and must not be grouped under one undifferentiated function-word class.
claims.boundary: Each profile requires its own placement, host, negation, question, lexical-collision, and construction boundaries.

claims.claim: 佢食緊飯 attests postverbal progressive 緊 in an ongoing activity clause, but it does not establish unrestricted compatibility with stative or achievement predicates.
claims.boundary: Predicate class, placement, negation, and aspect interaction require controlled evidence.

claims.claim: 你去過日本未 contains experiential 過 plus final 未 and must remain distinct from perfective 咗 questions, preverbal 未 negatives, and A-not-A exact-copy questions.
claims.boundary: The source does not establish every regional, lexical, or discourse restriction of the exact profile.

claims.claim: The lesson's one-gloss descriptions of 啦, 㗎, 呀, 嘞, and 囉 are pedagogical simplifications rather than complete particle meanings.
claims.boundary: Tone, host clause, discourse context, prosody, clusters, and orthographic variation remain explicit.

claims.claim: 畀碗湯佢 instantiates lexical GIVE with theme before recipient, matching the characteristic neutral Cantonese bei2 order.
claims.boundary: Do not merge lexical GIVE with passive, permissive, recipient-marker, or benefactive 畀 profiles.

claims.claim: Recipient-before-theme 畀佢一碗湯 is not freely equivalent to neutral theme-before-recipient order and requires marked-context, weight, focus, topicalization, or contact-influence review.
claims.boundary: No categorical impossibility is claimed; variants must retain their conditioning factors.

claims.claim: Clause-final 嘅 in 佢唔飲咖啡嘅 and final 啦 in the following imperative contribute discourse structure separate from the dative argument order.
claims.boundary: Do not analyze clause-final 嘅 as attributive or nominalizing solely by character identity, and do not assign 啦 one context-free force.

claims.claim: The 23 spatial items divide among region nouns, localizers, scalar distance predicates, orientation markers, route-motion predicates, cardinal-direction regions, endpoint nouns, distributive place expressions, and compounds.
claims.boundary: No catch-all locative or directional label and no free word-order rule is authorized.

claims.claim: 的士站, 渡輪, 纜車, and 港鐵 are Hong Kong transport/place attestations requiring reading, register, compositionality, and overlap review before lexical ingress.
claims.boundary: Absence of a modular entry is not sufficient evidence for adding an opaque whole.

claims.claim: 十億 through 一百億 are compositionally structured; the English values align with ten hundred-million units through one hundred hundred-million units.
claims.boundary: Do not create ten opaque numeral entries.

claims.claim: The six tone-paradigm rows are pronunciation material only and contain five explicitly blank saam- cells.
claims.boundary: No character, reading, tone label, lexical suitability, or missing cell is accepted or silently completed without item-level verification.

disposition.nextEvidence: Use the follow-up ledger for noun-specific classifier tests, direct particle and ge3 research, dative-context contrasts, spatial corpus inventories, transport lexical review, and tone verification.
